aboutAppDescription: Khayati is a smart platform specializing in tailoring services. It connects users with professional tailors to craft garments with precision, transparent pricing, and quality assurance — all tracked in real time.
aboutAppFeature1Sub: Elite professional tailors delivering precise, high-quality tailoring services
aboutAppFeature2Sub: Enter measurements, pick fabrics and design — get a tailoring experience made for you
aboutAppFeature3Sub: Tailor rankings based on execution quality, commitment, and real customer reviews
aboutAppFeature4Sub: Communicate directly with your tailor to ensure every detail is right before work begins

faqQ1: How do I order a custom garment via Khayati?
faqQ1Answer: Tap "Khayati" from the home screen, then specify the garment details you want such as budget and timing. Tailors will receive your request and submit their proposals. You can then pick the best offer and confirm the order.
faqQ1Sub: Simple steps to order the perfect outfit
faqQ2Answer: All tailors are subject to regular customer reviews. The platform also provides a rating and review system after every order is received.
faqQ2Sub: A clear mechanism to ensure your order details
faqQ3: Can I cancel an order after confirmation?
faqQ3Answer: You can cancel within a defined window after confirmation. Once the tailor has started working, a full refund is not guaranteed without reviewing with customer support.
faqQ3Sub: Cancellation policy depends on order status
faqQ4: How are the right tailors selected?
faqQ4Answer: The platform uses a transparent rating system that includes quality, punctuality, and real customer reviews to ensure the best experience.
faqQ4Sub: Selection based on quality and reliability
faqQ5Answer: The platform supports multiple payment methods including credit cards, bank transfers, and digital wallets. All payments are protected with high-level encryption.
faqQ6: How long does order delivery take?
faqQ6Answer: Delivery time varies by tailor location and order type. An estimated delivery time is shown upon order confirmation.
faqQ6Sub: Depends on tailor location and region

privacy1Body: We collect information you provide when registering or using the app, including account names, phone numbers, email addresses, order and measurement data. All credit/debit cards’ details and personally identifiable information will NOT be stored, sold, shared, rented or leased to any third parties. https://khayati.ae/ will not pass any debit/credit card details to third parties.
privacy2Body: Khayati uses your data to provide a precise and personalized experience, including account creation, connecting you with the right tailor, payments in AED, order tracking, and service notifications. Once payment is made, confirmation is sent by email within 24 hours of receipt.
privacy3Body: https://khayati.ae/ takes appropriate steps to ensure data privacy and security including through various hardware and software methodologies. However https://khayati.ae/ (website) cannot guarantee the security of any information that is disclosed online. https://khayati.ae/ is not responsible for the privacy policies of websites to which it links.
privacy4Body: The Website Policies and Terms & Conditions may be changed or updated occasionally to meet the requirements and standards. Therefore, the Customers are encouraged to frequently visit these sections to be updated about the changes on the website. Modifications will be effective on the day they are posted.
privacyIntroBody: Privacy Policy - Khayati (HAMAD ALADAWI SERVICES BROKERAGE). United Arab Emirates is our country of domicile. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect and protect information you share with us within the app and at https://khayati.ae/.
